theorems.name: Submission.dohr_vel_area_integrand_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P' (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P' (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) P ∧ ∀ Ψ : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, fderiv ℝ (fun P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P' (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P' (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) P Ψ = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))) * ∑ a : Fin n, ∑ c : Fin n, ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))⁻¹ a c * inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single c (1 : ℝ))) (Ψ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))
